actions.oldValue: Tony Best Musical winner that opened Nov 2022 and ran 612 performances until Apr 2024. Low $7M cap and lean $570K/week costs, but modest grosses meant it only reached about halfway to breakeven by closing. Grossed ~$35M total. Second consecutive Best Musical Tony winner to close without recouping (after A Strange Loop).
actions.newValue: Tony Best Musical winner that opened Nov 2022 and ran 612 performances until Apr 2024. Low $7M cap and lean $570K/week costs, but modest grosses meant it only reached about halfway to breakeven by closing. Grossed ~$35M total. Playbill reported on Apr 23, 2026 that the Broadway production had recouped, with profits from the national tour letting it return the rest of its capitalization.
actions.description: kimberly-akimbo-2022: notes no longer say it closed without recouping

actions.oldValue: Closed Oct 2025 without recouping. Actual capitalization $24.25M (not $26M). $7.5M of investor money used to convert Kit Kat Club venue owned by ATG (the lead producer's parent company). Active investor lawsuit alleging producers used investor funds to improve their own real estate. Weekly nut $1.5M proved unsustainable. Investors received 0% recovery.
actions.newValue: Closed Oct 2025 without recouping.
